name: LH-4808-DEX-01
summary: A robot joint servo-drive board with EtherCAT / CAN FD communication. It accepts a 40–60 V supply and specifies 25 A maximum phase current, with overcurrent, undervoltage and overvoltage protection thresholds.

description.en: A robot joint servo-drive board with EtherCAT / CAN FD communication. It accepts a 40–60 V supply and specifies 25 A maximum phase current, with overcurrent, undervoltage and overvoltage protection thresholds.
